edition.title: Euclidis opera omnia, Elementa, vol. II: Libros V-IX continens
edition.rights: Public domain. University of Toronto, Gerstein Science Information Centre copy, digitized by the Internet Archive.
edition.date_note: Internet Archive metadata gives 1883; this volume II title explicitly prints MDCCCLXXXIV (1884). The workshop follows the volume title.

rendering: pdftoppm -f 28 -l 31 -scale-to 1800 -jpeg -jpegopt quality=88 INPUT.pdf full; title PDF p.7 at -scale-to 1400. Complete pages without cropping or retouch.

transcription.scope: V definitions 3-7, with definition 5 also divided into linked reading clauses. The Latin clause for arbitrary multiplication is an explanatory note, not an invented quotation.
normalizations: Line wrapping and end-of-line hyphenation removed.
Greek theta glyph normalized to Unicode theta; iota subscripts and accents retained.
Apparatus and superscript reference markers omitted in reading selections, retained in the complete pages.
transcription.boundaries: English, language notes, square-diagonal examples, exact arithmetic, search ordering, grid and proof exposition are modern teaching work. The algebraic footnotes printed on pp.3 and 5 are Heiberg’s, not Euclid’s.
